verdict.rationale: Licensing terms are a fair question for a local LLM runtime that also has a cloud offering, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never states Ollama's license, whether commercial or enterprise use is permitted free of charge, or whether a paid tier is required. The pricing-page item only lists a cloud feature ("Run multiple models concurrently"), which says nothing about commercial-use licensing.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know whether commercial or enterprise use requires a paid license or subscription beyond the free community edition
